title: ROUTE-STATE record, schema route-state/1 (PROTO-DEC-0235)
vocabulary: type (string | number | integer | boolean | object | array | null, or an array of these)
notes: Every field of a route is an object with an explicit tag: declared or measured. A field without a tag, or with the tag of the other kind, is refused by the one reader (tools/operator-knowledge/route-state.cjs).

The field name decides the kind: balance, limit, plan and price are declared fields and only tools/operator-knowledge/declare.cjs writes them; probe and performance are measured fields and only tools/operator-knowledge/refresh.cjs writes them.

A declared field names the owner act that declared it (a decision id, or owner message|answer|directive|word with the date) and the moment the value stops being a fact: expiresAt. A measured field names measuredAt, expiresAt and the writer in source.

An expired declared value is not a value: stateAt returns null for it. Only the fields named in requiredDeclared decide availability; an expired or future-dated OPTIONAL declared field is informational and never changes the route state. Nothing carries an old value forward.

Every string of the record - a value, a key, a source, a reason - is one line of visible, well-formed text. The one reader refuses a line break, a control character, an invisible/format character and a lone surrogate with RECORD_STRING, and both writers use the same function.

performance is advisory history (verdict share, wall time, tokens). Its expiry prevents old numbers from being carried forward, but it never decides the availability of the route; only probe and the fields named in requiredDeclared do.

probe.value.reason is a closed set of names, never raw client output: TIMEOUT, SPAWN_FAILED, EXIT_NONZERO, NO_ANSWER, AUTH_FAILED, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, PAYMENT_OVERDUE, NO_CREDITS, RATE_LIMITED, invalid-model-name, temp-unavailable, SERVED_MISMATCH, SERVED_FAMILY_MISMATCH. reason is null exactly when ok is true. probe.value.at is the envelope's measuredAt (F06).

probe.value.served (PROBE-SERVED-MODEL) is the model id the probe PROVED answered, and servedSource says from where (client-banner, launcher-model, agent-result, client-log); never from the words of the model. Both keys are written together: served null goes with servedSource none (the served model is not proven), a string goes with a source other than none. A probe that is ok but names no proven served model, and every probe written before these keys existed, reads unproven: stateAt adds SERVED_UNPROVEN and the route is never ok. An ok probe whose served model is not the route model is refused by the reader (RECORD_PROBE_SERVED); a proven mismatch is written as a failed probe (SERVED_MISMATCH, or SERVED_FAMILY_MISMATCH when the maker families differ).
The schema is a JSON Schema subset checked by the one reader; a sample violating each rule must fail in the tests of the reader.

coverage (optional, PROTO-DEC-0240 item 2) is the operator's record that every route in use has a row. While it is absent or complete is false, a launch whose client and model match no route is admitted with a recorded transition line; complete=true makes the same launch a refusal (ROUTE_UNKNOWN). recordedBy names who recorded it, recordedAt when.
